policy.principle: Approved principles registry v0.1 creates a governance container for approved principles and a review queue for eligible hypotheses. It does not auto-approve principles.

review_queue.proposed_principle_statement: Policy and regulatory changes affect industrial outcomes through cost, incentive, compliance, or capacity-support channels.
review_queue.expected_direction: Policy measures change firm behaviour by altering costs, incentives, constraints, or available support.
required_before_approval: Confidence score accepted or adjusted by reviewer.

governance.note: This object places a tested hypothesis into an approval queue. It does not approve principles automatically.

review_queue.proposed_principle_statement: External demand shocks propagate through export-sensitive sectors before appearing in broader manufacturing outcomes.
review_queue.expected_direction: Demand-sensitive sectors weaken first during external downturns and may recover earlier when demand conditions improve.
required_before_approval: Confidence score accepted or adjusted by reviewer.

governance.note: This object places a tested hypothesis into an approval queue. It does not approve principles automatically.

review_queue.proposed_principle_statement: Inventory adjustments amplify manufacturing downturns and recoveries by causing production changes that exceed the underlying change in demand.
review_queue.expected_direction: Inventory drawdowns deepen production cuts; restocking supports production recovery.
required_before_approval: Confidence score accepted or adjusted by reviewer.
